reader_notes: Prose reads as high-quality British-register feature journalism; sentence rhythm and vocabulary are consistent throughout, no calques or register slips.

Internal numbers reconcile on a careful second read: two-fifths at commissioning, 18/19 within a point or two in year one, ~4% frequency drop by year ten (~7% in the three heaviest fit-outs), less than half the benefit by year eight, 4 of 19 retuned.

Q5 rests on a fine distinction between what Rask concedes to Marek ('a shape survives a change of owner') and what the writer withholds ('neither is obviously the safer bet'); it is derivable, but it is the hardest item in the set and a strong student may need two passes over the final paragraph.
